scenes.headline: How three model sizes fit inside one network
scenes.sub: Matryoshka suites: 500M, 1.5B and 3B, nested and trained once.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Churro! Model suites train every size as its own run. Matryoshka suites nest them inside one network, like dolls. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: If the small model's parameters are a subset of the large one's, then training the large one trains the small one.
scenes.mark: a subset of the large one's
scenes.say: The idea: make the small models' parameters a subset of the big one's, and training the big one trains them all. Three point two billion parameters, not five point two.

steps.say: Block one is twenty-four layers. On its own, with its own output head, it's the five hundred million model.
Block two is wider. Block one's output is rescaled to the norm of fresh embedding channels, then concatenated with them. The junction adds no parameters.
Block three is the widest, five more layers, and that's the three billion model. Every exit detaches as an ordinary checkpoint.
And distillation is free: every forward pass already computed the big model's logits, so they teach the smaller exits at every step.

left.title: Independent 500M draft
items: Its own layers and its own KV cache
Under nucleus sampling, slower than not speculating
left.say: A separately trained draft has its own layers and cache. Under nucleus sampling, speculating with it is slower than not speculating.

right.title: Nested 500M draft
items: It is the verifier's first 24 layers
One shared KV cache; only upper blocks verify
right.say: The nested draft is the verifier's first twenty-four layers. The cache is shared, only the upper blocks run to verify, and the two agree more.

scenes.label: greedy, at draft length 6, against 2,100 for the independent pair
scenes.say: At draft length six, the nested pair decodes two thousand six hundred fifty tokens a second, against two thousand one hundred.

scenes.text: Relate the small model to the big one by construction, and suites, distillation and drafting come almost free.
scenes.say: Relate the small models to the big one by construction, and training them, distilling them and drafting with them come almost free.

recap: Three exits nested in one 39-layer network
A junction with no parameters: rescale, then concatenate
Free distillation, and a draft that shares the cache
scenes.say: To recap: nested exits, a parameter-free junction, free distillation, and a draft that shares the cache.
